name: extra-time-live-status-fix
purpose: Prevent live World Cup matches in extra time or penalties from being displayed as finished before ESPN reports final/full time.
rules: If status/phase says live, in play, extra time, penalties, first half, second half, or has live flags: display مباشر.
Do not display انتهت بعد التمديد just because score.et exists; only display it when the status is actually final/AET/finished.
During live matches, prefer score.current/live/et before ft so the visible score follows the live score.
If a live match has no score yet, display 0 - 0 instead of a dash or a wrong status label.
